correctness.rationale: For an output block at sites 0,1,2 the input window is at -1 through 3; two consecutive blocks share exactly the last two input bits of one window and the first two of the next. Thus labeled paths from the full set of boundary pairs characterize finite phase-aligned realizability. Shifts by multiples of three respect the rule assignment. Extending any finite prescribed output segment to aligned block boundaries gives finite solvability from all-block realizability; compactness of the bilateral binary full shift and closed preimage cylinders give a full preimage. Subset reachability from 15 to 0 therefore decides onto-ness and shortest length, with BFS run to actual closure; a shortest path to 0 cannot repeat a nonempty state. An independently written integer-array census constructs one-site maps and composes them, rather than building five-bit three-site windows as the supplied checkers do. A bounded four-way partition over the first rule covers every one of 16,777,216 triples exactly once. For shortest lengths 0 (onto), 1, 2, 3, 4 the exact counts are 12888, 7476480, 8825488, 453144, 9216; every higher bin is zero. Single-site automata detect precisely 30 homogeneous onto rules and give survivor masks 000 through 111 of 0,0,0,928,0,928,928,10104. Independently the witness (22,22,90) first reaches the empty set at depth four and repeated 010 gives masks 15,7,6,2,0. The triple (23,60,102) reaches closure without zero, with only its first constituent non-onto homogeneously. These confirm the full census, rigidity, and both sharpness claims under the stated block alignment.

value.rationale: Mixing elementary rules spatially asks when globally onto behavior survives heterogeneous local dynamics. The first period beyond simple alternation gives a complete finite benchmark, a sharp uniform decision horizon much smaller than the generic subset-state bound, and a precise constraint on how many individually non-onto constituents can be rescued. Both sharp examples clarify the meaning of the census, and the phase scope is natural because period-three rescaling gives a block shift.
residual_risks: No broader structural characterization for arbitrary rule periods or arities; the threshold is for aligned whole three-cell blocks only.
